question: What happens to those who reject this teaching?
premises: disparagers do not follow the teaching
they are deluded and lost in knowledge
the unfaithful are destroyed by recurring fear
inference: rejecting the teaching leads to delusion and destruction through fear
uncertainties: fused compound vinaṣṭāḥ-avirataṃ keeps hyphenated surface
plain_english: Those who disparage and do not follow this teaching are deluded and lost; the unfaithful in this knowledge are destroyed continuously because of fear of birth and death.
